paragraphs: Shmuel bar Nachum, [Bava Kamma 55a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.55a.2). Another Amora named Nachum is mentioned in [Shabbat 88b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.88b.8), but Hyman says the name there should read R' Tanchum, as in [Sukkah 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.5a.3).[^1]

notes.text: The parallel explanation about God spreading the radiance of the Divine Presence over Moses is attributed to Rabbi Nachum in Shabbat and Rabbi Tanchum in Sukkah. Hyman prefers Tanchum in both.
